RBA rate hikes continue squeezing household spending, pressuring consumer discretionary and financials
Saudi oil shock and diesel supply concerns send Australian fuel prices surging, raising inflation risk
Aussie flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic activity
Gold miners (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina) and rare earths (Critica/Jupiter) attract capital rotation
10-year US Treasury yield surges to 2007 high on two Fed hike bets, pressuring global risk assets
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees; Qantas confirms Sydney-New York non-stop
Property market weakens: rising listings, falling demand pushing prices lower
Nuclear energy debate intensifies in Australia amid energy cost concerns
China rebalancing towards robotics; Chinese property recovery question marks persist

sectors.trend: Miners outperform on ASX; gold names (Critical Resources, Aurum $52.5M raise, Platina $2M Rio cheque) and rare earths (Critica/Jupiter offtake) see capital inflows. Iron ore stable but China property recovery uncertain.
sectors.implications: Rotation into gold and critical minerals offers relative strength; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX supported by commodity resilience but capped by China demand questions.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggle on ASX despite Saudi oil shock lifting fuel prices. Diesel supply fears and potential export ban create volatility. Nuclear energy debate gains political traction.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face margin pressure from input costs; downstream refiners may benefit from fuel price surge. Nuclear policy shift could create long-term structural opportunity.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending; NIMs supported but credit growth at risk. 10-year yield surge pressures bond portfolios.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates short-term but face rising NPL risk as household budgets tighten. Watch credit card and home loan delinquency data.

sectors.trend: Tech leads ASX on Wall Street AI/Nvidia momentum. $16B Aussie tech firm faces China-link controversy. Renishaw records on AI chip boom.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names benefit from global AI capex cycle but China exposure creates geopolitical risk. Monitor CSL.AX tech-adjacent plays and any ASX-listed AI infrastructure names.

sectors.trend: Biotech stocks dive globally with top 2% names hardest hit. Syngenis gains precision medicine firepower. Mixed signals for ASX healthcare.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, SVL.AX may see selective pressure; precision medicine and gene therapy sub-sectors attract M&A interest.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; Qantas confirms SYD-JFK non-stop. Fuel costs hit consumer budgets. Half of young adults living with parents signals weak consumer confidence.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk from Jetstar (JQZ.AX) industrial action. WES.AX, WTW.AX pressured by fuel-cost-driven consumer caution.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand push property prices lower. Chinese property recovery uncertain. GGP CMBS refi signals US CRE stress.
sectors.implications: ASX REITs (GPW.AX, ICV.AX, DGL.AX) face valuation pressure from rising yields and soft demand. Selective opportunities in logistics and data centre REITs.

key_themes: RBA tightening cycle vs. softening PMI and household spending
Energy transition: nuclear debate, diesel supply shock, fuel price inflation
Gold and critical minerals rotation amid geopolitical uncertainty
AI/tech capex supercycle vs. China decoupling risks
US Treasury yield spike (2007 high) pressuring global valuations
Australian consumer squeeze: fuel, housing, migration policy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price inflation from Saudi oil shock and diesel supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour downstream refiners and energy-efficient transport names; monitor AEMO and APMA data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike cycle compressing household spending and credit growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favour dividend-paying financials with strong capital buffers; monitor NAB/CBA credit metrics

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US 10-year yield surge to 2007 high spilling into AUD and global risk assets
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD/USD exposure; reduce duration in fixed income; favour cash-flow-positive equities over growth multiples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action disrupting aviation sector
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid JQZ.AX near-term; QAN.AX benefits from competitor disruption but watch cost pass-through

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China demand uncertainty for iron ore and Australian exports
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from single-commodity exposure; favour gold and critical minerals with Western offtake

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fiscal sustainability: federal and state governments approaching debt cliff
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor sovereign credit metrics; favour infrastructure and defence names with government contract visibility

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical minerals names amid geopolitical rotation and China uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources Suriname grab, Aurum $52.5M raise, Platina Rio cheque, and Critica/Jupiter offtake signal sector momentum; gold hedges yield spike

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical overweight ASX tech on global AI capex cycle
opportunities.rationale: Tech leads ASX; Nvidia streak and Renishaw record results confirm AI infrastructure demand; data centre buildout supports long-term revenue

opportunities.recommendation: Favour Qantas on Jetstar industrial action disruption
opportunities.rationale: Jetstar staff waiving fees signals service degradation; QAN.AX captures market share; SYD-JFK non-stop adds premium revenue

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hikes squeezing spending; rising property listings and falling demand; fuel inflation eroding household budgets

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and reduce fixed-income duration
defensive_moves.rationale: 10-year yield at 2007 high; global risk-off from US yield spike; AUD under pressure from commodity softness
Oil stocks struggling on ASX; diesel supply volatility creates margin uncertainty; nuclear policy shift is long-dated catalyst

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative. RBA tightening, soft PMI, and fuel inflation cap upside. Tech and gold provide pockets of strength. Jetstar industrial action and oil volatility add noise. 10-year yield spike is the dominant global headwind.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and PMI stabilises. Gold/critical minerals structural demand, AI capex cycle, and potential nuclear policy shift offer multi-year themes. China property recovery and fiscal sustainability remain key swing factors.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement
Australian CPI and flash PMI print
Trump-Xi meeting outcome and China trade policy
US Fed rate path (two hikes priced in)
Diesel supply resolution / export ban decision
watch_list: Iron ore, gold, LNG spot prices
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Jetstar (JQZ.AX) and Qantas (QAN.AX) share price action
Chinese property PMI and sales data
ASX REIT occupancy and cap rate trends
